run_pr_latency_report: run the script to measure PR latency for open pull requests in the grpc repo
run_pr_latency_csv: run the script with csv output format to export PR latency data to a spreadsheet
run_pr_latency_kokoro: run the script filtering by the kokoro CI system to measure test completion latency
run_pr_latency_jenkins: run the script filtering by the jenkins CI system to measure test completion latency
run_pr_latency_with_token: run the script with a GitHub API token to avoid rate limiting on API requests
